repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: CC Switch是基于Tauri 2的跨平台桌面应用，为Claude Code、Codex和Gemini CLI提供统一管理平台。该工具解决开发者在多AI编程助手间切换的痛点，集成API中继服务配置，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统。具备轻量级、高安全性特点，可显著提升AI辅助开发效率，实现一站式AI编码环境管理。
repos.summary_en: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2 that unifies management of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It eliminates workflow fragmentation by centralizing API relay configurations and model switching in a single interface. The lightweight, secure app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, streamlining AI-powered development and boosting developer productivity through consolidated tool management.

repos.description: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
repos.summary_zh: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
repos.summary_zh: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
repos.summary_en: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.summary_zh: Sure 是一款开源个人理财与财富管理应用，由社区维护的 Maybe Finance 分支发展而来。支持 Docker 自托管，提供浏览器、macOS 桌面、移动端、API 及 LLM 代理等多种客户端，内置 AI 助手解答财务问题，帮助用户全面掌控现金流、净资产与消费支出。
repos.summary_en: Sure is an open-source personal finance and wealth management app, a community-maintained fork of Maybe Finance. It supports Docker self-hosting and offers multiple clients including browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API, and LLM agents. An AI assistant answers financial questions, helping users track cashflow, net worth, and spending.

repos.description: The most full featured web-to-app toolkit on Android, a complete APK workshop that runs entirely on your phone
repos.summary_zh: WebToApp 是一款运行在 Android 手机上的完整 APK 构建工具，可将 Web 项目直接打包为原生应用。无需 PC 或远程服务器，支持执行服务端运行时、签名 Google Play 包、运行 MV3 浏览器扩展，并内置抗审查网络栈，是移动端开发者的离线构建利器。
repos.summary_en: WebToApp is a full-featured on-device Android APK builder that converts web projects into native apps directly on your phone. It supports server runtime execution, Google Play signing, MV3 browser extensions, and an anti-censorship network stack — no PC or remote server required.

repos.description: 🤖 Keep your forks up-to-date via automated PRs
repos.summary_zh: Pull 是一款 GitHub App，通过自动化 PR 保持 fork 仓库与上游同步。基于 Deno 2.0 和 TypeScript 构建，支持 merge、squash、rebase 和硬重置等多种同步策略。可定时检测上游变更，自动创建 PR 并分配审查者，兼容分支保护规则。提供灵活的 YAML 配置，支持 GitHub Enterprise Server，解决了开发者维护 fork 时的手动同步痛点，提升开源协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Pull is a GitHub App that automates fork synchronization with upstream repositories via pull requests. Built on Deno 2.0 and TypeScript, it supports configurable merge strategies including merge, squash, rebase, and hard reset. The app periodically checks for upstream changes, automatically creates PRs with assignees and reviewers, and respects branch protection rules. With flexible YAML configuration and GitHub Enterprise Server support, it eliminates manual fork maintenance overhead and streamlines open-source collaboration workflows.

repos.description: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections
repos.summary_zh: 基于Xposed框架的Android隐私保护模块，通过拦截应用列表请求隐藏已安装应用，防止其他应用检测Root工具来识别设备Root状态，同时抵御基于应用列表的指纹追踪，并提供隐藏效果验证功能。
repos.summary_en: An Xposed module for Android that intercepts app list requests to hide installed applications from other apps. It prevents apps from detecting root-related tools (such as Fake Location or Storage Isolation) that would reveal a device is rooted. Additionally, it blocks apps from using app list enumeration as fingerprinting data or for other nefarious purposes. The module also provides built-in verification methods to test whether app list hiding is working properly, ensuring comprehensive privacy protection on rooted Android devices.

repos.description: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

repos.description: Standalone iOS app to spoof GPS location without jailbreak. Includes Shadowrocket/Surge/Loon/QX/Stash module.
repos.summary_zh: 无需越狱的iOS GPS位置伪造工具。利用代理软件HTTPS解密与MITM功能，拦截Apple定位响应，修改WiFi及蜂窝基站坐标，实现任意地点定位。基于原Go项目移植为JavaScript模块，适配Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon等五大平台。新增多格式兼容、运动状态伪造等功能。适用于隐私保护、应用测试与地图验证，配置参数简单，即导即用。
repos.summary_en: A jailbreak-free iOS GPS location spoofer that intercepts Apple's location responses via proxy apps' HTTPS decryption and MITM. It modifies WiFi and cell tower coordinates to fake any location. Ported from an original Go app to JavaScript modules for Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, and Stash. Adds cell tower spoofing, multi-format support, and motion state faking. Ideal for privacy protection, app testing, and map verification with simple config parameters.

repos.description: Medium Unlocker (now Freedium App) is an android app designed to access Medium, NYT, Bloomberg, Washington Post, Financial Times, Reuters, The Economist articles without any paywalls.
repos.summary_zh: Freedium（原Medium Unlocker）是一款Android原生应用，基于Java+WebView实现，支持通过Freedium与Archive.is镜像无障碍阅读Medium、纽约时报、华盛顿邮报、彭博、路透社、经济学人及金融时报文章。提供分享接收、深度链接、镜像自动切换、历史书签、阅读位置记忆、Markdown复制及离线友好功能，解决多订阅墙痛点。
repos.summary_en: Freedium (formerly Medium Unlocker) is a native Android app built with Java and WebView that unlocks paywalled articles from Medium, NYT, Washington Post, Bloomberg, Reuters, The Economist and Financial Times via Freedium and Archive.is mirrors. It offers share-sheet integration, deep links, auto-fallback mirrors, history, bookmarks, scroll memory, Markdown export and offline-friendly reading for casual multi-publisher access.

repos.summary_zh: SatellaJailed 是一款专为 iOS 12-16 设计的应用内购买破解工具，支持非越狱（jailed）和部分越狱设备。通过动态库注入技术，它能在应用购买流程中拦截并绕过苹果的支付验证机制。工具提供三种安装方式：电脑脚本自动打补丁、Azula 应用补丁和 Esign 签名集成，支持 TrollStore 和 Dopamine 环境。使用时发起购买后取消确认弹窗即可。核心功能默认启用，iOS 15+ 用户可开启高级选项。注意并非所有应用都兼容。
repos.summary_en: SatellaJailed is an iOS 12-16 in-app purchase cracker designed for jailed and partially jailbroken devices. It employs dynamic library injection to intercept and bypass Apple's payment verification during purchase flows. The tool offers three installation methods: computer-based script patching, Azula app patching, and Esign signature integration, compatible with TrollStore and Dopamine environments. Users initiate a purchase and cancel the Apple ID confirmation popup to activate. Core functionality is enabled by default, with advanced features available for iOS 15+. Note that not all applications are supported, and success rates may vary depending on the target app.

repos.summary_zh: AppStore++ 是一款基于 TrollStore 的 iOS 越狱插件，允许用户直接降级已安装的 App 至任意历史版本。它集成 AppStore 搜索、版本兼容性检测、IPA 库管理及应用数据备份，支持 iPad 分屏界面，为越狱用户提供便捷的应用版本管理方案。
repos.summary_en: AppStore++ is a TrollStore-based iOS jailbreak tweak that lets users downgrade installed apps to any historical version. It integrates App Store search, version compatibility detection, IPA library management, and app-data backups, with iPad split-view support, offering a convenient app version management solution for jailbroken devices.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: How top iOS apps say hello | 10 animated welcome screens inspired by top-earning apps. Rebuilt in React Native + Expo.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 React Native Expo 项目，收录 10 个受 Duolingo、Strava 等热门 iOS 应用启发的动画欢迎/启动/引导屏幕。每个均为完整 TypeScript 组件，基于 Reanimated 实现精准时间轴动画、响应式缩放、无障碍与减动画支持。开发者可直接运行画廊、复制组件或粘贴 AI 提示词快速集成，专为学习高端移动端 onboarding 设计而打造。
repos.summary_en: Open-source React Native Expo kit with 10 animated welcome, splash and onboarding screens inspired by top iOS apps like Duolingo and Strava. Each is a full TypeScript component powered by Reanimated, featuring authored timelines, responsive scaling, reduced-motion and accessibility support. Run the gallery, copy any component or paste AI prompts to integrate polished mobile onboarding UI for study or production use.

repos.description: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
repos.summary_zh: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
repos.summary_en: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.
